what: The work group report under Chapter 887 of 2026 (Senate Bill 278). The Virginia reports library lists it as overdue on 16 November 2026
body: Secretary of Health and Human Resources
official_words: The Secretary shall submit a report on the work group's findings and recommendations to the Chairs of the Senate Committees on Finance and Appropriations and Education and Health and the House Committees on Appropriations and Health and Human Services no later than November 1, 2026.

what: Each 340B covered entity's yearly report to the hospital trade association, under Hawaii's 340B law of 2025 (HB 712)
official_words: Beginning on July 1, 2026, and no later than July 1 each year thereafter, each 340B covered entity shall report to the hospital trade association operating in the State

what: The hospital trade association's public yearly report of what covered entities reported, under Hawaii's 340B law of 2025 (HB 712)
body: Hospital trade association operating in the State
official_words: No later than October 1, 2027, and each year thereafter, the hospital trade association located in the State shall make the report publicly available

what: Each 340B covered entity's yearly report to the General Assembly, under the Patient Access to Pharmacy Protection Act (HB 2371). Some kinds of entity report from 2029
official_words: On or before August 1, 2026 and each August 1 thereafter, a 340B covered entity shall submit a report to the General Assembly pursuant to this Section. For the purposes of this Section, the following covered entities are exempt until January 1, 2029 and will report on or before August 1, 2029 and each August 1 thereafter: hospitals with fewer than 100 licensed beds, Critical Access Hospitals, Safety-Net Hospitals, and 340B grantees.

what: The Department of Healthcare and Family Services' Medicaid study report to the General Assembly, under the Patient Access to Pharmacy Protection Act (HB 2371)
body: Department of Healthcare and Family Services
official_words: By January 1, 2028, the Department of Healthcare and Family Services shall report to the General Assembly

what: The Department of Insurance's report of the findings of its study, under the 340B Transparency, Reporting, and Accountability Act (HB 4327)
official_words: The Department of Insurance shall submit a report of the findings of its study to the General Assembly and to the Governor by July 1, 2028.

what: Each 340B covered entity's yearly report to the Commissioner of Health, under Minnesota Statutes 62J.461
official_words: Each 340B covered entity shall report to the commissioner by April 1 of each year

what: The Commissioner of Health's yearly report to the legislature, under Minnesota Statutes 62J.461

what: Each 340B covered entity's yearly report to the Department of Health, under Ohio Revised Code 3701.88
official_words: Not later than July 1, 2026, and not later than the first day of July in each year thereafter, each 340B covered entity shall submit a report to the department of health.
